scene: You crest the ladder onto a breezy weather-vane catwalk.
picture: A flat side-view along a steel catwalk. On the far left, a humming round barometer with a large brass dial. Centre stands the player in his burnt-orange jacket, beanie, and prosthetic leg, brass telescope over his shoulder. Right sits a giant spinning copper rooster vane. Far right, an arched metal skybridge leads away.
